post.caption:
Photosynthesis: light energy splits water, carbon from CO₂ is assembled into glucose, and the oxygen is dumped as waste. That waste is what every animal on Earth breathes. Reframe oxygen as plant exhaust and the whole reaction suddenly makes sense.
